Remember how on the phone I said I always blank out in exams? I tried your trick. I sat down and listed every exam from Class 10 till now where I didn't blank out. Pradeep

passage: When I was fifteen, Lalit sir held up my charcoal sketch of a rain-soaked bus stop in front of the whole class and said, 'Siddharth, this is what I mean by mood.'
